LanguageData.DMS_DecoySite.label: remnant relay station
LanguageData.DMS_DecoySite.description: A decommissioned remnant signal relay station. Its transmitter array can be repurposed to lure high-value automatroid units - if its garrison is dealt with first.
LanguageData.DMS_DecoySite.arrivedLetter: You have arrived at the relay station. Hostile automatroids garrison the compound.\n\nYour presence will not go unnoticed for long: once the station's monitoring protocol identifies you, enemy reinforcements will begin to arrive.
